name: Hardened steel mail suit
description: Head-to-ankle hardened steel mail: a coif, sleeves and legs in one suit. Heavy, but little gets a blade through it. Wear something padded under it.
notes: The model's root: mail in `steel-mail-dark`. Folded with the coif laid face up at +z: sleeves rolled down each side, the legs folded up over the front, the face opening painted dark. Folded on a shelf it is wide and its box mostly empty. Slot `vest`, the body armour slot; no slot spans the whole body, so it should also block the head, arms and legs slots once a slot can cover more than one region. It covers the head as well, so it should not stack with a separate mail coif; left to the worn-coverage rules. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Faraday mail suit
description: Tempered steel mail from scalp to toes, mitts and socks included, with a wire grille over the face and every part bonded into one cage. Current that strikes it runs round you instead of through you. Worn over ordinary clothes.
notes: Its own model in `steel-heat-tint`, as the tempered mail leggings have it: the mail suit's pile with a coif face up at +z whose face opening is barred by a bright wire grille, mail mitts hanging over the front fold, mail socks on the leg ends and a braided bonding strap down the middle. Folded on a shelf it is wide and its box mostly empty. Slot `vest`, the body armour slot; no slot spans the whole body, so it should also block the head, arms and legs slots once a slot can cover more than one region. Deadvox has no electric damage kind, so the shielding goes unmodelled; propose one when shocks exist. Protection is a judgement for tempered mail, a little under hardened because the cage gaps at the face. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Cleansuit
description: A disposable hooded coverall of white spun plastic with elastic cuffs and booties. It keeps dust and fallout off your skin and clothes, but tears easily.
notes: Folded with the hood face up at +z: zip flap down the front, elastic cuffs, booties folded over the front fold. `cloth-bright-white` reads pale grey in the tiles. Folded on a shelf it is wide and its box mostly empty. Slot `suit` is new: a one-piece protective coverall goes on over all other clothing and covers the whole body, so no earlier slot fits. Radiation protection has no Deadvox damage kind; it is listed impervious to acid splashes as the rubber boots are. Wears fast. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Entry suit
description: A firefighter's silvered whole-body suit with gauntlets and a hood behind a gold-faced visor, made to walk into flames for a short while. Bring your own air.
notes: Folded with the hood face up at +z: silvered cloth in `foil-alu`, a `foil-gold` visor in a turnout-cloth rim, a zip flap and attached gauntlets on top. Slot `suit` is new: a one-piece protective coverall goes on over all other clothing and covers the whole body, so no earlier slot fits. Heat and fire have no Deadvox damage kind; the protection is a judgement for its aramid layers. A breathing set or gas mask goes separately. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hazmat suit
description: A sealed yellow suit with a broad face window, gloves and boots joined on, made to keep chemicals and contaminated dust off you entirely. Tight on the move and easy to tear. Wear a gas mask inside it.
notes: Folded with the hood face up at +z: `rubber-yellow` suit, a clear face window with a black rim, a zip flap, green gloves on top and black boots sealed to the legs standing out behind. Slot `suit` is new: a one-piece protective coverall goes on over all other clothing and covers the whole body, so no earlier slot fits. Impervious to acid, as the rubber boots are; radiation protection has no Deadvox damage kind. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
